message.en: Stars align perfectly today — your bias era starts now! ✨

message.ja: 今日は星が完璧に並ぶ日 — あなたの推し時代の幕開け！✨

message.en: You're fully in your element today — ride the wave! 🌊

message.en: The universe has your back today — lean into it! 🍀

message.en: A little resistance makes you stronger — you've got this! 🔥

message.en: A calm, steady day — perfect for planning your next era! 🌤️
